senses.gloss: m. (φολλερόν = φόλλις, S., v. בּוֹלְרִין) folleron, a small debased coin.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:36">Y. Peah I, 15ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מילה דטבא חד פ׳</he> a thing which is worth one folleron; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35:3">Gen. R. s. 35</cite>, end; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 934:1">Yalk. Prov. 934</cite> <he>מילתא אחד פלן</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>פּוֹלְרִין</he>, <he>פּוֹלְרֵי</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:14">Gen. R. s. 70</cite> <he>אי … בי׳ פ׳ יהיב ליה חמשה פ׳</he> when labor was worth ten follera, he (Laban) gave him five; <he>ואם … בו׳ פ׳ הוה יהיב ליה בג׳ פ׳</he> and if the load he brought in was worth six follera, he (Jacob) gave it to him for three.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:4">Gen. R. s. 49</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00498"><he>עִיגּוּלָא</he></cite>.
